en: The postcard features a black-and-white historical photo of a large group of soldiers or military personnel gathered for a concert in front of a building with a tall clock tower and steep tiled roofs, resembling a church or town hall. There is a covered pavilion or bandstand where musicians are performing, with several horse-drawn carts and many people in military uniforms. The caption at the top reads 'Sonntag-Nachmittag-Konzert im Felde (Osten)' in German.
